q: In 2 Chronicles, if God's people humble themselves and pray, what will He heal?
quote: then I will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.

q: In 2 Chronicles, when Solomon finished praying, what came down from heaven?
quote: When Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering

q: In 2 Chronicles, what did Solomon ask God for to lead the people?
quote: Now grant me wisdom and knowledge, so that I may lead this people.

q: In 2 Chronicles, when a vast army came against Judah, to whom did the battle belong?
quote: for the battle does not belong to you, but to God.

q: In 2 Chronicles, who went out in front of King Jehoshaphat's army?
why: God set ambushes for the enemy.
quote: and appointed those who would sing to the LORD and praise the splendor of His holiness.

q: In 2 Chronicles, which queen came to test Solomon with hard questions?
why: She brought camels with spices and gold.
quote: Now when the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon, she came to test him with difficult questions.

q: In 2 Chronicles, why could the priests not minister in the new temple?
quote: so that the priests could not stand there to minister because of the cloud

q: In 2 Chronicles, what did the singers proclaim when the temple filled with a cloud?
quote: For He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

q: In 2 Chronicles, where do the eyes of the LORD roam?
quote: For the eyes of the LORD roam to and fro over all the earth

q: In 2 Chronicles, what broke out on King Uzziah when he burned incense in the temple?
quote: leprosy broke out on his forehead.

q: In 2 Chronicles, King Hezekiah said Assyria had only what on its side?
quote: With him is only the arm of flesh, but with us is the LORD our God to help us

q: In 2 Chronicles, after God answered his prayer, what did King Manasseh know?
quote: Then Manasseh knew that the LORD is God.

q: In 2 Chronicles, which Persian king did God stir to send a proclamation?
quote: the LORD stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia to send a proclamation

q: In 2 Chronicles, what did Cyrus say God appointed him to build?
quote: has appointed me to build a house for Him at Jerusalem in Judah.

q: In 2 Chronicles, how many years did King Joash reign in Jerusalem?
why: He began at seven years old.
quote: and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years.

q: In 2 Chronicles, which priest went in after King Uzziah to stop him?
why: Eighty brave priests went with him.
quote: Then Azariah the priest, along with eighty brave priests of the LORD, went in after him.

q: In 2 Chronicles, in which year of his reign did young Josiah begin to seek God?
why: He later cleansed Judah of idols.
quote: In the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, Josiah began to seek the God of his father David

q: In 2 Chronicles, when did the LORD set ambushes against Judah's enemies?
quote: The moment they began their shouts and praises, the LORD set ambushes
